hooks.text: 自由建设宗门并安排不同天赋弟子采集、炼丹、种田与外派
hooks.excerpt: Enjoy the freedom of placing buildings, creating an elegant and visually pleasing sect unique to your taste. Assign tasks to disciples with different personalities and talents, allowing them to gather resources, construct, work, rest, and cultivate. Engage in activities like tea tasting and chess matches, simulating a realistic path to immortality. Additionally, you can refine artifacts, make pills, grow spiritual fields, and assign disciples to complete missions off the mountain, bringing life and vitality to your sect!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每次攻击都需精准输入并规划路线，再组合弟子能力完成进攻
hooks.excerpt: Every attack requires precise player input and strategic route planning, combined with disciple abilities and skills to achieve the perfect offense, making every battle a victory.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 不同宗门在新周目拥有独立地图、剧情与专属科技特征
hooks.excerpt: Brand-new maps: Beautiful and atmospheric, with mountains embracing rivers in a breathtaking, Penglai-like wonderland! Independent storylines: Different sects have unique storylines, offering a fresh experience every time! Innovative technologies: Add sect characteristics with new technology gameplay for each sect!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
